question.text:
In the circuit shown, initially there is no charge on capacitors and keys S1 and S2 are open. The values of the capacitors are C1=10 μF, C2=30 μF and C3= C4=80 μF.

Which of the statement(s) is/are correct?

options.text: If key  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is kept closed for long time such that capacitors are fully charged, the voltage difference between points  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></math>  will be  <math><mn>10</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>.</mo></math>

The keys  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is kept closed for long time such that capacitors are fully charged. Now key  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is closed, at this time, the instantaneous current across  <math><mn>30</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>  resistor (between points  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></math> ) will be  <math><mn>0.2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>  (round off to  <math><msup><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></msup></math>  decimal place).

At time  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math>  the key  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is closed, the instantaneous current in the closed circuit will be  <math><mn>25</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>.</mo></math>

If key  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is kept closed for long time such that capacitors are fully charged, the voltage across the capacitors  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math>  will be  <math><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>.</mo></math>
